instruction.text: Decide whether the statements are true or false.

atoms.a: The transatlantic slave trade was terminated in 1807, prior to the domestic one.
A cause of the American Civil War between 1861 and 1865 were differences between East and West.

wrong.text: Economic differences between North and South were a key cause.

atoms.a: 13th, 14th and 15th Amendment were passed before the American Civil War.

wrong.text: They were passed after Civil War, in the 1860s.

atoms.a: Martin Luther King Jr. delivered the speech “I have a dream” during the Montgomery bus boycott.

wrong.text: He gave it during the March on Washington.

atoms.a: Barack Obama became the second Black President of the US in 2008.
The Montgomery bus boycott in 1955 resulted in desegregation of public buses.
Issues of racially motivated police brutality still exist today.
Martin Luther King Jr. and Malcolm X both fought for equality of African Americans.
Malcolm X used boycotts to achieve his goals.

wrong.text: It was Martin Luther King Jr. who did so.

atoms.a: Rosa Parks dedicated a significant part of her life to the civil rights and justice movements.

atoms.b: It began in the ((17))th century, when the first enslaved Africans were brought to the US. After a long period of slavery, the American ((Civil)) War in the 19th Century led to the end of the transatlantic slave trade in the US. Formerly enslaved people slowly gained some legal rights as enshrined in the 13th, 14th and 15th ((++Amendment ++Amendments)).

One of the most important moments in the struggle for civil rights was the action of Rosa Parks in ((1955)). It led to the ((Montgomery)) Bus Boycott, which resulted in the desegregation of public buses. A major leader of the Civil Rights ((Movement)) was Martin Luther King Jr., who advocated for ((++non-violent ++nonviolent)) protests. During his travels to India, he found himself inspired by the non-violent principles of Mahatma ((Gandhi)).

In contrast to Martin Luther King Jr., ((Malcolm)) X took a different approach and advocated for immediate empowerment, using any means necessary. He became a representative of the Nation of ((Islam)) and grew the membership. The struggle for African American rights continued into the 20th and 21st centuries. An example of racially motivated police brutality is the killing of George Floyd in ((2020)).
